appSecretPlaceholder: Secret from the QQ Open Platform
instructions:
1. Open the QQ Open Platform (q.qq.com) and create a bot
2. Copy the AppID and AppSecret
3. Enable group-chat and C2C messaging intents
4. (Optional) Fill in Main QQ below — only those senders can DM the bot; slash commands stay restricted to them in groups too.
5. To find your OpenID: message the bot once, then copy the sender ID from the connection status.
mainQqHint: OpenIDs are not QQ numbers. Message the bot once from your QQ account and copy the sender OpenID shown here. Leave empty to accept all private chats.
